description: For moving estimate, this inspection checklist records revised services, labor and vehicle basis, materials, specialty handling, valuation, storage, discounts, and exclusions. Its supporting evidence includes inventory delta, access confirmation, specialty photos, rate basis, third-party quote, and customer change request.

items: Origin and destination access facts match the current survey
Inventory quantities and specialty items are reconciled
Stairs, elevators, parking, carries, and reservation needs are recorded
Packing, storage, valuation, and third-party services are identified
Customer exclusions and changed assumptions are conspicuous
Photos, dimensions, schedule constraints, and follow-up questions are linked

title: Moving Estimate Inspection Checklist
use_case: Use the inspection checklist during moving estimate revision and decision record when the moving estimate record must identify customer account, survey version, origin and destination constraints, inventory revisions, dates, and access reservations. Complete the applicable handoff for selected option, estimate version, deposit status, schedule lock, move-file handoff, and open prerequisites.
